nodes.title: Malformed HTTP configuration's result_detail states its malformed-key vocabulary
nodes.summary: unavailableFor's MalformedHttpConnectorConfigurationError branch now routes through a dedicated enrichment that appends the error's own already-computed problems to result_detail, keyed to exactly the key(s) actually malformed, mirroring unavailableForUnreachableConnector's established enrichment pattern.

nodes.title: A malformed HTTP connector configuration's result_detail states its vocabulary
nodes.summary: Five tests in the adapter's existing spec file -- four corrected in place, one newly added -- establish that unavailableForMalformedHttpConfiguration's result_detail states the error's name plus exactly the vocabulary of whichever key(s) are actually malformed, and issues no HTTP call.
